about: How a tank with fuel in it goes up when it is destroyed (docs/sandbox/CONSTRUCTS.md, 'Fuel blasts'). A tank's energy-litres are the litres it held at that moment times its fluid's 'energy' (a fluid not listed doesn't burn); a designed weapon with no warhead counts its motors' and tanks' fuel at 'propellantPerKg' a kg. Below 'minLitres' there is no blast. Radius: 'radiusBase' + 'radiusPerCubeRoot' x cube root of the energy-litres, at most 'maxRadius' (100 m or more is a shock front); damage at the middle: 'damageBase' + 'damagePerRoot' x square root, at most 'maxDamage'; crater: 'craterPerRadius' of the radius, at most 'maxCrater' m. It goes off 'delayTicks' after it breaks, plus up to 'staggerTicks' more by its place in the body, so a chain ripples.
